title: The First Christians
objective: After this level you can describe how Christianity began and spread through the Roman world.
summary: Jesus was crucified in Judaea under Pilate. Paul and others carried the faith to the cities of the empire along Roman roads.

cards.headline: A faith from a small province spread along roads that Rome had built.
From Judaea
cards.body: Jesus of Nazareth was a Jewish teacher executed by crucifixion in Judaea under the Roman governor Pontius Pilate, who governed Judaea from 26 to 36 CE. Paul of Tarsus spread Christianity to non-Jews in cities around the eastern Mediterranean.

cards.headline: How it spread
cards.body: Christianity spread mainly in cities, helped by Roman roads, peace and the common Greek language of the East. Christians worshiped one God and refused to sacrifice to the Roman gods or to the emperor.

cards.fact: Early churches looked after their own.
cards.context: Christian communities were led by bishops and cared for their poor, widows and sick, even when the faith itself was under attack.

cards.headline: The faith: spreading
learned: Paul spread the faith to non-Jews
